title: Open the jobs map
text: Log in to Homlle. Click the map pin on the left to open Jobs Map. Here you can look for work near you.

title: Check the job
text: Select a job and read its details. Check the location, time, pay and tasks. Only accept work you can safely complete.

title: Accept the job
text: On your dashboard, click Accept job. Your accepted job appears in your schedule. Open the booking when you are ready to go.

title: Read the customer instructions
text: Read the access details and customer notes. Check what needs doing before you start. If anything is unclear, contact the customer.

title: Arrive and start
text: Use Start journey when you leave, then record your arrival at the property. When ready to begin, click Start cleaning.

title: Complete the checklist
text: Do each task first. Then click Mark task complete beside it. Repeat for the remaining tasks. Record any problem honestly.

title: Add your completion photos
text: Photograph the finished work. On your phone, use Take a job photo. This example uses Choose existing photo to select a picture.

title: Upload the photo
text: Choose After cleaning. Link the task and add a useful note. Click Upload securely. Wait for confirmation that your photo has saved.

title: Finish the clean
text: Check your work and all tasks. Save the completion photos and record any issues. Click Finish cleaning, then confirm when asked.

title: The customer checks your work
text: The customer opens your private photos and checks the task record. Clear photos help them see what you have completed. Keep personal information out.

title: Customer confirmation
text: When satisfied, the customer clicks Confirm job complete. That completes the booking. You can check your records in Activity and Earnings.
